title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：satisfaction　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 satisfaction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the elder ① showed the satisfaction that no youth in the village would have described, and he said the showing was the whole of the year. The ② satisfaction, meaning the contentment itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; satisfaction, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of satisfaction in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ satisfaction at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Satisfaction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the elder said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the satisfaction was the whole of the matter, meaning the pride and not the contentment. The ⑥ satisfaction, meaning the pride and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; satisfaction, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both contentment and a pride. He said the pride is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ satisfaction had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ satisfaction of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of describing; satisfaction, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ satisfaction I remember is the satisfaction described in the memoir, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Satisfaction, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being described; all satisfaction, she said, is a pride that has agreed to look like contentment. She said the pride was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 满意；满足（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 满意；满足（指那份满意本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the satisfaction 表露这一份满意
D. n. 满意；满足（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 满意之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的满意之事）
F. n. 满意；满足（指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一份）
G. n. 满意、得意（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 得意（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the satisfaction that no youth in the village would have described
The satisfaction, meaning the contentment itself and not the staff
Every bit of satisfaction in that village
the satisfaction at the far gate
the satisfaction was the whole of the matter
the satisfaction had become a line in a memoir
The satisfaction of the whole thing

answers.why: show the satisfaction 意为“表露这一份满意”，1960 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯描述的一份满意做了一遍。
satisfaction 意为“满意；满足”，指那份满意本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
satisfaction 意为“满意；满足”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
satisfaction 意为“满意；满足”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
satisfaction 意为“满意、得意”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份得意就是那件事的全部。
satisfaction 意为“得意”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份满意，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
satisfaction 意为“满意；满足”，指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一份，到 1965 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
satisfaction 意为“满意之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的满意之事是一处村子和三个年头的描述。
satisfaction 意为“满意；满足”，我记得的是回忆录里描述过的那一份，1967 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
satisfaction 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，满意是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的满意。
